{{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Soup Ladle Icon.png |caption= A [[Soup Ladle]] |pronunciation= |plural= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= |uses= Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Daily Use Goods|Daily Use Goods|BotW, AoC, Series}} are a recurring archetype of [[Weapon]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 169}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Daily Use Goods are a series of [[Weapon]]s that were initially made as tools for domestic life.{{Cite|{{Big|Soup Ladle}}
A kitchen implement often used for serving delicious soups. It was carved from the wood of a sturdy tree, so it actually packs quite the wallop.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Farming Hoe}}
A farming tool primarily used for tilling fields. Its fine craftsmanship is sturdy enough to withstand backbreaking fieldwork, but its battle applications are untested.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Boat Oar}}
Made for paddling boats, but it was made sturdy enough to fight strong currents. Maybe it's useful for self-defense in a pinch.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Wooden Mop}}
Just a mop to the untrained eye, it excels at tidying up the place. But it owes its sturdy construction to a true craftsman, so it actually has some combat merit.|Inventory|BotW}} However, due to their composition, many of them can find use in combat situations. With the exception of [[Farming Hoe]]s, all Daily Use Goods are considered wooden Weapons. This means that they will float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They do not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, and they cannot be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. ====List of Equipment==== {| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; max-width:57.5em; text-align:center" |- !style="width:25%"| Item !style="width:10%"| Strength !style="width:10%"| Durability !style="width:55%"| Description |- | [[File:BotW Torch Icon.png|link=]]
